Hello.

Rosemarine was created by a biologist. Every soap, shampoo and cream is made by hand in small batches and tested in a laboratory.

Soaps go into cloth pouches, creams and balms into sterilised glass, and the boxes are kraft paper. The packaging should look after nature too.

We have one goal: organic living in every family.

With love,
Rosemarine

We chose another way.
